snippet.title: Accursed // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/1968830/Accursed/

Accursed is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a mysterious ever-changing house in a slow-paced, atmospheric world and survive long enough to discover its terrible secret... if you dare

Developed by
Johan Croix

Note: Yes I realize the trailer says "Early 2023" at the end but game dev takes time, lets give them a chance
